title: Even code of a partite matching
statement: Let $r,k\in\mathbb{N}$ with $k>0$, and let a perfect matching be given in the complete multipartite graph with $2r$ parts of size $k$. The associated even code is its raw matching code, together with the assertion that it satisfies the even partite matching condition.
hypotheses_covered: A perfect matching in the complete multipartite graph with $2r$ parts of size $k$
